# unraid_shares (Data Source)

All user shares. Requires `READ_ANY` on `SHARE`. Shares are read-only: the Unraid API has no mutations for creating or changing shares.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_shares" "all" {}

output "share_names" {
  value = [for s in data.unraid_shares.all.shares : s.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `shares` (Attributes List) List of user shares. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shares))

<a id="nestedatt--shares"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shares`

Read-Only:

- `allocator` (String) Allocation method, e.g. `highwater`.
- `cache` (Boolean) Whether the share uses a cache pool.
- `comment` (String) Share comment.
- `cow` (String) Copy-on-write setting.
- `exclude` (List of String) Disks excluded from the share.
- `floor` (String) Minimum free space.
- `free_kb` (Number) Free space in KB on the disks/pool backing the share (not per share).
- `id` (String) Share identifier.
- `include` (List of String) Disks included in the share.
- `luks_status` (String) Encryption status.
- `name` (String) Share name.
- `size_kb` (Number) Total size in KB.
- `split_level` (String) Split level.
- `used_kb` (Number) Used space in KB on the disks/pool backing the share (not per share).
